systems.name: 2.1 ACS VM Enhancements
systems.notes: Expand the ACS virtual machine to support more opcodes, nested scripts, and advanced control flow. Improve error handling and debugging hooks.
tasks: Support more ACS opcodes (math, string, arrays)
Implement nested script calls and ENTER/RESPAWN scripts
Add script debug logging and error reporting

systems.name: 2.2 Extended Line Specials & Sector Actions
systems.notes: Add support for all classic line specials: doors, lifts, stairs, lighting changes, teleporters, etc.
tasks: Implement remaining ZDoom line specials (Light_Change, Floor_Lower, etc.)
Handle sector special triggers (secret, damage, friction)
Implement line activation types (walk-over, shoot, use)

systems.name: 2.3 Script Scope & Variables
systems.notes: Implement proper variable scoping (world, global, map) and array handling in ACS.
tasks: Support ACS arrays and map arrays

systems.name: 2.4 Polyobjects & 3D Floors
systems.notes: Support polyobject movement (sliding doors, swinging) and 3D floor definitions for advanced level geometry.
tasks: Parse and create polyobject anchors and segments
